title: VLLNT UI native parity matrix
description: Classifies every @vllnt/ui web component against @vllnt/ui-native. Shapes, enums and patterns live here; scripts/check-parity.mjs reads them and also enforces the cross-field rules and the drift checks against the web component directories and registry.json.

target.description: The native release the native-0.1.0 status refers to.

category.description: Foundation groups first, then the other groups. Doc sections follow this order.

affordanceState.description: Contract states: rest, hover, focus-visible, pressed, selected, disabled. unknown means the component file did not make the answer clear and must stand alone.

level.description: Atomic level of the web component directory.

status.description: native-0.1.0: in the 0.1.0 native release (built, or planned when missing is true). web-only: stays web-only, reason required. later: a native release after 0.1.0, reason and target required.

foundation.description: Part of the FOUNDATION set that 0.1.0 must cover. Must be native-0.1.0, or web-only when it maps to a native equivalent.

missing.description: true on a native-0.1.0 foundation entry means planned, not built yet. Remove it when the module lands in registry.json.

source.description: Native module path, identical to the registry.json source. Only on built native-0.1.0 entries.

target.description: Native release that should ship it. Required for later and later than 0.1.0.

dependency.description: What building it would need (package, component or decision).

nativeEquivalent.description: Native component or export that covers the use case. Required on a foundation web-only entry.

interactive.description: Foundation only: the component is an interactive control.

affordance.description: Foundation, interactive only: contract states the native component styles today.

propsGap.description: Foundation components on both platforms: web props with no native counterpart, DOM-only props ignored. Empty means none.

propsRenamed.description: Web prop name to the native prop that replaces it.

decision.description: true when the classification is an open question for review; question is then required.

status.description: planned: not in registry.json yet. built: has a native module in registry.json.
